_comment: Canonical vectors for the minimum-power guard (abproof#3), run through EVERY statistics
twin in the family so the verdict is a mechanical invariant rather than a review-time
The guard exists because a battery with too few discordant pairs cannot reach alpha at
any effect size: the exact two-sided sign-flip test has a hard floor of 2/2^n, since only
the all-positive and all-negative assignments reach the extreme deviation out of 2^n.
Reporting such a run as PASS says 'we looked and found no regression' when it means 'we
Consumers (each asserts the same verdict for the same input, in its own CI):
Why both must agree: per ADR-0055 `dotclaude measure run` invokes abproof as a ghcr bridge
image and FAILS OPEN to the linked in-tree twin. If only the published side carries the
guard, an unavailable container silently degrades the run to the implementation that
cannot say UNDERPOWERED — fail-open into fail-silent, on the honesty guard itself. That
is not hypothetical: dotclaude#34 ran entirely on the fallback path
_floor_note: min_attainable_p(n) = 2/2^n for n >= 1, and 1.0 for n == 0 (every pair tied — no signal).
The operative consequence at alpha=0.05: unreachable at n <= 5, reachable from n = 6.
n is the DISCORDANT-NODE count, never node x rep: each node contributes one delta, the
mean over its reps. Reps can break ties among the nodes you have (a stochastic node that
ties at one rep may not at four, and Pratt drops exact zeros) but cannot raise the
ceiling, which is the battery size.

floor._case: a stricter alpha moves the threshold up, and the twins must move together

_verdict_note: outcome = UNDERPOWERED if the floor exceeds alpha, else FAIL if (worse && p < alpha),
else PASS. The guard is DIRECTION-BLIND on purpose: a battery with no power to detect a
regression did not establish its absence just because the point estimate improved.
UNDERPOWERED and a confirmed regression are mutually exclusive by construction.

verdict._case: the defect this guard fixes — worse, unanimous, still cannot reach alpha
direction-blind: treatment improved, but the battery still proved nothing
every pair tied — absence of evidence, not evidence of absence
powered and significant — the guard must stand aside
powered, worse, but not significant — an honest non-confirmation
